text:
morgan: Heads up — since we rolled nccl 2.25.4 into us-west1 canaries last night we've been seeing intermittent allreduce stalls on multi-GPU inference jobs. Tail latency spikes (99.9pct) up 6-10x and a few timeouts. Trying to gather details.

anita: ugh. which instance types? A100? driver version?

morgan: A100s (80GB) on us-west1-gpu-pool-3, driver 535.86.01, cuda 12.2. Affected containers show repeated `NCCL WARN` lines and then `NCCL ERROR TIMEOUT` after ~45s.

devon: can you paste an excerpt of the logs? also are p2p or nvlink errors present?

morgan: paste of stderr from one failing pod:
```
I0912 01:23:45.123456 12345 nccl_comm.cu:442] NCCL WARN : 192.168.3.12: peer connect failed, retrying
I0912 01:23:46.567890 12345 bootstrap.cu:210] NCCL INFO : using p2p level 2
I0912 01:24:30.000000 12345 coll_net.cu:777] NCCL ERROR TIMEOUT : Allreduce op timed out after 45000 ms
```
No explicit nvlink firmware messages, but p2p connect fails show up often.

jia: thanks. Do we see this only on 2.25.4? Any hits on older nccl images (2.24.x)?

morgan: Correct — the same job against a 2.24.6 image in a different pool runs cleanly. Canary nodes with 2.25 are ~15% failing at tail rather than 0. Repro on 2.25 seems consistent under 64-token batches and >1GPU shards.

samir: are there network-level changes? MTU, CNI, or kernel upgrades in that pool recently?

morgan: We did bump the node kernel to 6.1.0-arch-optimized (security backport) a week ago, but didn't expect NCCL to care. No CNI changes. I/O metrics look normal.

clara: if p2p is flaky, maybe fallback to p2p_level=1 temporarily to avoid nvlink/pci peer issues. But that'll hit perf.

devon: agree. For customers on Dedicated, perf regression is visible in graphs — cost and SLA risk. We should prioritize revert if it affects production.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: build-2219 promoted to us-west1-canary (image: redwood/inference:prod-2026-09-nccl-2.25.4)

anita: what's the impact on capacity? Are autoscalers spinning up more nodes because of slower throughput?

morgan: yes — autoscaler triggered extra nodes for several queues, increasing costs ~18% on that pool overnight. Also a few customer requests timed out and were retried which magnified load.

jia: propose plan: (1) roll back canary to 2.24.6 images for us-west1-canary, (2) mark 2.25.4 as blocked for rollout pending root cause, (3) run targeted stress tests across driver 535 + kernel 6.1 to repro. agree?

samir: +1. Also add a quick mitigation we can flip via runtime env: set NCCL_P2P_LEVEL=1 and NCCL_IB_DISABLE=1 for affected deployments as emergency config. That should be low-risk and reversible.

devon: would p2p_level=1 reduce cross-GPU perf to unacceptable levels for some SLAs? we need to classify customers who must be excluded.

clara: It reduces peak throughput but keeps latency more stable. For Dedicated pro customers we should coordinate with CSM before changing. For host-api ephemeral workloads ok.

morgan: I'll open a rollback PR and start rolling canary back now.

anita: please include the following checks in the PR: smoke with 1/2/4 GPU shards, seq-len 64/512, collect NCCL logs and kernel dmesg snapshots.

morgan: noted. Starting rollback rollout to canary group 1 (10% of canaries). infra-bot, please tag the rollout.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: rollback initiated for redwood/inference:prod-2026-09-nccl-2.24.6 -> us-west1-canary group1

morgan: after rollback to 2.24.6, early canary results look good — error rate drops back to baseline in the first 40min. Still running extended validation.

samir: good. Can we reproduce locally in our perf lab with the same kernel/driver combo? We should try to get a minimal repro case for NVIDIA.

jia: also file an upstream NVIDIA ticket. get log bundles and network captures (tcpdump) for when a peer connect fails.

devon: long term: add a preflight compatibility matrix test in our CI that runs small cross-GPU collectives across nccl/driver/kernel combos before we promote images.

clara: Agreed — also add an alert to the console: sudden 99.9 latency increase for any pool after image change should auto flag and pause rollout.

morgan: action items tracked in the thread: rollback canary (in progress), collect logs + tcpdump, reproduce in perf lab, file NVIDIA case, block 2.25.4 until confirmed. I'll update once rollback completes.

anita: thanks. ping me if rollback fails or if Dedicated customers are impacted before we get CSM looped in.

morgan: will do. :thumbsup:
